FixesColsOff.name: FixesColsOff
FixesColsOff.statement:
abbrev FixesColsOff z :=
  z * (1 - inclMatrix R e * (inclMatrix R e)ᵀ) = 1 - inclMatrix R e * (inclMatrix R e)ᵀ

rowStabilizer.name: rowStabilizer
rowStabilizer.statement:
noncomputable def rowStabilizer : Subgroup (GL N R) := .copy (s := {A | FixesColsOff e A.1 ∧
  w * A.1.map φ = w}) (MulAction.stabilizer .. ⊓ ((MulAction.stabilizer _ w.row).comap
  Units.opEquiv.symm.toMonoidHom).unop.comap (GeneralLinearGroup.map φ)) rfl

columnDatum.name: columnDatum
columnDatum.statement:
noncomputable def columnDatum σ :=
  ite (w * map σ φ = w * inclMatrix S e) (χ (submatrix σ e id).det) 0

columnDatumMul.name: columnDatum_mul_ite_eq
columnDatumMul.statement:
lemma columnDatum_mul_ite_eq {F : _ → ℂ} (hF : ∀ A ∈ rowStabilizer φ w e, ∀ y, F (A.1 * y) = F y)
  (y : Matrix N a R) z : columnDatum χ φ w e (z.submatrix id e) * ite (FixesColsOff e z) (F y) 0 =
  ite (∃ Z ∈ rowStabilizer φ w e, Z = z) (χ z.det * F (z⁻¹ * y)) 0

binders.name: hF
binders.type: ∀ A ∈ rowStabilizer φ w e, ∀ y, F (A.1 * y) = F y

HasWeightNormLe.name: HasWeightNormLe
HasWeightNormLe.statement: def HasWeightNormLe (p : Prop) κ F b := ∃ ξ, toPoly (Φ := Φ) n κ ξ = F ∧ (p → weylNormSq ξ ≤ b)

HasWeightNormLeProd.name: HasWeightNormLe.prod
HasWeightNormLeProd.statement:
lemma HasWeightNormLe.prod {p ι} {s : Finset ι} {κ F b} :
  (∀ i ∈ s, @HasWeightNormLe Φ n _ _ p (κ i) (F i) (b i)) →
  HasWeightNormLe p (s.sum κ) (s.prod F) (s.prod b)

binders.type: (∀ i ∈ s, @HasWeightNormLe Φ n _ _ p (κ i) (F i) (b i))

ChosenGL.name: LevelPlaces.ChosenGL
ChosenGL.statement: abbrev LevelPlaces.ChosenGL (r : Type) [Fintype r] := ∀ i, GL r (ResField (S.chosenPlace i))

firstBlockHom.name: firstBlockHom
firstBlockHom.statement:
def firstBlockHom : S.ChosenGL r →* ∀ i, GL n (ResField (S.placeAt i)) :=
  .pi (rec ((extendGL u).comp <| Pi.evalMonoidHom _ ·) fun _ ↦ 1)

auxLevel.name: auxLevel
auxLevel.statement:
def auxLevel : Subgroup (∀ i, GL n (ResField (S.placeAt i))) := pi .univ (rec
  (fun i ↦ MulAction.stabilizer _ (inclMatrix (ResField (S.placeAt (inl i))) u).col) fun _ ↦
  rangeParabolic u)

AuxPair.name: AuxPair
AuxPair.statement:
structure AuxPair extends LevelPlaces E where
  signs : r → _
  W : Space E r signs
  incl : r ↪ n
  ord : r → ℕ
  (colsPlus colsMinus : InfinitePlace E → ℕ → ℕ) μ : AutChar E
  (weight ψ) hasWeight : μ.HasWeight weight ψ
  tame_eq_one : ∀ w ∉ toLevelPlaces.places, ψ w = 1
  rank_lt : card r < card n

resDetDatum.name: AuxPair.resDetDatum
resDetDatum.statement:
def resDetDatum (X : ∀ i, Matrix n r (ResField (O.placeAt i))) := if ∀ i, X (inl i) =
  inclMatrix _ O.incl then ∏ i, O.ψ _ ((X (inr i)).submatrix O.incl id).det else 0

auxKappa.name: AuxPair.κ
auxKappa.statement: abbrev κ := mixedWeight n O.colsPlus O.colsMinus

detExp.name: AuxPair.detExp
detExp.statement: abbrev detExp τ := -((∑ i ∈ .Ico 1 (card n), O.colsMinus τ i :) : ℤ)

auxLevelChar.name: AuxPair.auxLevelChar

FormV.name: AuxPair.FormV
FormV.statement: abbrev FormV := O.LevelForm _ O.auxLevelChar O.κ O.detExp

chosenGLRep.name: AuxPair.chosenGLRep
chosenGLRep.statement:
def chosenGLRep {W} [AddCommGroup W] [Module ℂ W] (π : Representation ℂ _ W) :
  Representation ℂ (O.ChosenGL r) (levelSpace π _ O.levelChar) :=
  ⟨⟨fun g ↦ (∏ i, O.ψ _ (g i).1.det) • levelRep π _ (firstBlockHom _ O.incl) (by
  delta auxLevelChar firstBlockHom auxLevel LevelPlaces.placeAt Sum.elim
  simp [mem_pi, ↓mem_stabilizer_col_iff, inv_mul_eq_iff_eq_mul_of_invertible]
  simp_all [← Matrix.mul_assoc]) g, by simp⟩, by simp [← smul_mul_smul]⟩

formAction.name: AuxPair.formAction
formAction.statement: def formAction : Representation ℂ (O.ChosenGL r) O.FormV := chosenGLRep ..

tensorPoly.name: AuxPair.tensorPoly
tensorPoly.statement:
def tensorPoly := Fintype.linearCombination ℂ fun p : WeylIndex n _ × WeylIndex n _ ↦
  letterPoly O.signs O.ord 1 O.colsPlus (Pi.single p.1 1) * letterPoly O.signs O.ord (-1)
  O.colsMinus (Pi.single p.2 1)

tensorPolyVec.name: AuxPair.tensorPoly_vecMulVec
tensorPolyVec.statement:
@[simp] lemma tensorPoly_vecMulVec a b : O.tensorPoly (vecMulVec b a).vec =
  letterPoly O.signs O.ord 1 _ a * letterPoly O.signs O.ord (-1) _ b

auxA.name: AuxPair.a
auxA.statement: abbrev a : AutChar E := upsilonU1 ^ negCount O.signs

pairThetaKernel.name: AuxPair.pairThetaKernel
pairThetaKernel.statement: abbrev pairThetaKernel := pairThetaKer O.W (stdSpace E n) O.a O.b

auxDatum.name: AuxPair.auxDatum
auxDatum.statement:
def auxDatum := delta% vacuumDatum O.W (stdSpace ..) (O.levelModulus 2)
  (O.resDetDatum fun i ↦ ·.map (levelResidueAt i))

fockDatum.name: AuxPair.fockDatum
fockDatum.statement: @[simp] abbrev fockDatum ξ := integrated _ (O.harmonicPoly ξ) O.auxDatum.1

conjKernel.name: AuxPair.conjKernel
conjKernel.statement:
def conjKernel g h := IsLinearMap.mk' (R := ℂ) (fun ξ ↦ conj
  (pairTheta _ _ O.a O.b (O.fockDatum (star ξ)) (g, 1, h))) (by constructor <;> simp [pairTheta])

descent.name: AuxPair.θ
descent.statement:
def θ : O.FormV →ₗ[ℂ] G E O.signs → ℂ := by use ⟨fun Ξ g ↦ stdClassSum O.levelGroup fun h ↦
  O.conjKernel g h (Ξ h), ?_⟩ <;> simp [apply_eq_evalForm, classSum, Finset.mul_sum, funext_iff]

heckePolyOnForms.name: AuxPair.heckePolyOnForms
heckePolyOnForms.statement:
def heckePolyOnForms (X : ℂ) : Module.End ℂ O.FormV :=
  (heckePolyOp (algFormRep ..) hw X).restrict fun _ h ↦ have := (heckeSplit_mem_levelSpace
    hw · (LevelPlaces.LevelForm.mem_sphericalAt ⟨_, h⟩ hS) levelOf_le_Kf h)
  by simp [heckePolyOp, heckePolyEval, sum_mem, Submodule.smul_mem, *]

heckePolySmul.name: AuxPair.heckePolyOnForms_eq_smul
heckePolySmul.statement:
lemma heckePolyOnForms_eq_smul {y p} (h : IsSphericalWith (rightRegular ..) hw p y.1.1) X :
  O.heckePolyOnForms hw hS X y = p X • y

rankDiff.name: AuxPair.rankDiff
rankDiff.statement: abbrev rankDiff (_ : AuxPair E r n) := card n - card r

testValue.name: AuxPair.testValue
testValue.statement: def testValue w := (O.a.frobValue r w * w.q ^ (O.rankDiff - 1))⁻¹

Lifts.name: AuxPair.Lifts
Lifts.statement:
def Lifts (y : O.FormV) (z : _ → _) := ∀ w (hw : _ ≠ w), w ∉ O.places.conjClosure →
  IsSphericalWith (rightRegular ..) hw (fun T ↦ trivialHecke w.q O.rankDiff (O.a.frobValue r w *
  T) * heckePolyEval r w (z w) (w.q ^ O.rankDiff * O.a.frobValue r w / O.b.frobValue n w * T)) y.1.1

chosenModulusSq.name: LevelPlaces.chosenModulusSq
chosenModulusSq.statement: abbrev LevelPlaces.chosenModulusSq (S : LevelPlaces E) := S.levelModulus 2 false

mapBlock.name: map_block_eq_blockGL
mapBlock.statement:
lemma map_block_eq_blockGL {R} [CommRing R] f ε (k : Kf E N) (l : Kf E m) : ∃ h, Kf.map (S := R) n f
  ⟨U.block ε (k, l), h⟩ = reindexGL ε (blockGL (Kf.map N f k, Kf.map m f l))

placesLevelModulus.name: places_levelModulus_false
placesLevelModulus.statement:
lemma places_levelModulus_false {c} [NeZero c] : (S.levelModulus c false).places =
  Set.range S.chosenPlace

liftModSupported.name: liftMod_mem_supportedOn
liftModSupported.statement:
lemma liftMod_mem_supportedOn (B : GL n S.chosenModulusSq.ResRing) : ↑(liftMod B) ∈ supportedOn n
  (Set.range S.chosenPlace)

atPlaceTwist.name: atPlace_twistPlace_eq_one
atPlaceTwist.statement:
lemma atPlace_twistPlace_eq_one {k} (h : k ∈ supportedOn n (Set.range S.chosenPlace)) i :
  k.atPlace (S.twistPlace i) = 1

DividedSplitting.name: DividedSplitting
DividedSplitting.statement:
structure DividedSplitting (z : r ↪ m) extends ε : N ⊕ m ≃ n where
  ε_ι i : ε (inr (z i)) = O.incl i
  (fixedEmb : r ↪ N) (dividedEmb : a ↪ N) low : HasColumnsBelow n N O.colsPlus ∧
    HasColumnsBelow n m O.colsMinus

genIdeleApply.name: genIdele_apply_of_notMem
genIdeleApply.statement:
lemma genIdele_apply_of_notMem {w} : w ∉ Set.range O.chosenPlace →
  O.genIdele.1 w = 1

reductionZero.name: reduction_levelModulus_eq_zero_iff
reductionZero.statement:
lemma reduction_levelModulus_eq_zero_iff {c x} : (O.levelModulus c false).reduction x = 0 ↔
  O.genIdele⁻¹.1 ^ c * x ∈ Ô E

genResidue.name: DividedSplitting.genResidue
genResidue.statement: abbrev genResidue (_ : DividedSplitting N m a O z) := O.chosenModulusSq.reduction O.genIntAdele

binders.type: DividedSplitting N m a O z

genResidueSmul.name: DividedSplitting.genResidue_smul_eq_iff
genResidueSmul.statement:
lemma genResidue_smul_eq_iff {k c} (S : Matrix k c (O.levelModulus 2).ResRing) u :
    V.genResidue • S.map reduceToR₀ = V.genResidue • inclMatrix _ u ↔ ∀ i,
  S.map (levelResidueAt (inl i)) = inclMatrix _ u

binders.name: V
binders.type: DividedSplitting N m a O z

stackedDet.name: stackedDet
stackedDet.statement: def stackedDet := (((η.map C).fromRows (of fun a b ↦ X (τ, a, b))).submatrix id j).det

unitModulus.name: unitModulus
unitModulus.statement: abbrev unitModulus : Modulus E := ⟨⊤, top_ne_bot, (by simp [·.2.1])⟩

carrierForm.name: carrierForm

carrierXi.name: carrierXi
carrierXi.statement:
def carrierXi c h :=
  stdClassSum (Kf E (Fin m)) (modKernelI (n' := n') (stdSpace ..) c 1 (unitModulus E) 1 1 ⟨1, ·⟩ h)

detFromCols.name: exists_det_fromCols
detFromCols.statement:
lemma exists_det_fromCols (e : L ≃ a ⊕ N) Z : ∃ (Y : Matrix a L ℂ) (γ : ℂ), (∀ X, ((fromCols X
  Z).submatrix id e).det = γ * (Y * X)ᵀ.det) ∧ ‖γ‖ ^ 2 * ‖(Y * Yᴴ).det‖ ≤ ‖(Zᴴ * Z).det‖

twoSidedSubst.name: twoSidedSubst
twoSidedSubst.statement:
abbrev twoSidedSubst := aeval (R := ℂ) fun (τ, a, b) ↦ ∑ i, ∑ j,
  (c τ i a * g τ b j) • @X ℂ _ _ (τ, i, j)

inFirstCols.name: inFirstCols
inFirstCols.statement:
def inFirstCols := aeval (R := ℂ) fun (τ, a, b) ↦ (Sum.elim (X ⟨⟨τ, a⟩, @Fin.val p ·⟩)
  (C <| @X ℂ (Φ × N × L) _ ⟨τ, a, ·⟩) b : MatrixPoly (Σ _, N) _)

stackedDetProd.name: stackedDetProd
stackedDetProd.statement: def stackedDetProd := ∏ τ, ∏ k, stackedDet τ (M τ k) e

substStackedDetProd.name: twoSidedSubst_stackedDetProd
substStackedDetProd.statement:
lemma twoSidedSubst_stackedDetProd : twoSidedSubst c g (stackedDetProd e fun τ k ↦ M τ k * (g τ)ᵀ) =
    (∏ τ, ((c τ).det * (g τ).det) ^ card (ι τ)) • stackedDetProd e M

firstColsCoord.name: firstColsCoord
firstColsCoord.statement:
def firstColsCoord κ F l :=
  (hookNumber κ (rankAt N) : ℂ)⁻¹ • fockPairing _ (@inFirstCols Φ L N p F) (nablaBasis _ _ κ l)

substFirstColsCoord.name: twoSidedSubst_firstColsCoord
substFirstColsCoord.statement:
lemma twoSidedSubst_firstColsCoord {F F'} {s : ℂ} (H : twoSidedSubst c (fromBlocks 1 0 0 <|
  g ·) F' = s • F) κ l : twoSidedSubst c g (∑ l', schur κ c l l' • firstColsCoord κ F' l') =
  s • firstColsCoord (p := p) κ F l

binders.name: H
binders.type: twoSidedSubst c (fromBlocks 1 0 0 <| g ·) F' = s • F

posBlockEmb.name: posBlockEmb
posBlockEmb.statement:
@[simps!] def posBlockEmb : GInf E (1 : m → _) →* GInf E (blockSigns j) :=
  ((U.reindex j (by simp [signMatrix])).toMonoidHom.comp (U.inl 1 (-1))).compLeft _

posBlockEmbSpec.name: posBlockEmb_spec
posBlockEmbSpec.statement:
lemma posBlockEmb_spec k : (posBlockEmb j k τ)⁻¹.1.1 = posBlockEmb j k⁻¹ τ ∧ ↑(posBlockEmb j k τ) ∈
  blockDiagAlg (blockSigns j) ∧ principalMinor (posBlockEmb j k τ) (blockSigns j · = 1) =
  (k τ).1.1.det ∧ principalMinor (posBlockEmb j k τ) (blockSigns j · = -1) = 1

cardNegBlockSigns.name: card_neg_blockSigns
cardNegBlockSigns.statement: @[simp↓] lemma card_neg_blockSigns : card {i // blockSigns f i = -1} = card l

matchedPoly.name: matchedPoly
matchedPoly.statement:
def matchedPoly := (∏ τ, letterMinor τ (j ∘ inr) (f ∘ inr) ^
  (card (ι τ) + card n - 2 * card l)) * pairedDetProd (X ⟨·, j <| inl ·, f <| inl ·⟩) η

posFockVector.name: posFockVector
posFockVector.statement:
abbrev posFockVector := polyVector (realSigns E (homSigns (n' := a) (blockSigns j) 1)) ∘ₗ
  (renameRowsCols id (j ∘ inl)).toLinearMap

realWeilStackedDetProd.name: realPairWeil_stackedDetProd
realWeilStackedDetProd.statement:
lemma realPairWeil_stackedDetProd k u : realPairWeil γ 0 (posBlockEmb j k,
  u) (posFockVector j (stackedDetProd e fun τ ↦ (η τ · * (k τ).1.1⁻¹ᵀ))) = (∏ τ,
  (k τ).1.1.det ^ card (ι τ))⁻¹ • posFockVector j (stackedDetProd e
  η)

binders.name: hγ
binders.type: γ = fun τ ↦ (card l - card (ι τ) : ℤ)

realmatching.name: real_matching
realmatching.statement:
lemma real_matching : ∃ Q₀, ∀ v, ∃ κ, ∀ (ℓ : _ → _ →L[ℂ] ℂ) (ℓ' : _ →ₗ[ℂ] ℂ), (∀ g x w,
  ℓ g (realPairWeil γ 0 x w) = ℓ (g * x.1) w) → (∀ x Q, realPairWeil (s := blockSigns f) γ 0 (1,
  x) (polyVector _ Q₀) = polyVector _ Q → ℓ x v = ℓ' Q) → ∀ η,
  κ * ℓ 1 (posFockVector j (stackedDetProd e η)) = ℓ' (matchedPoly (ι := ι) f j η)

binders.name: hγ
binders.type: γ = fun τ ↦ (card l - card (ι τ) : ℤ)

isRapidModKernel.name: isRapid_modKernel
isRapidModKernel.statement:
lemma isRapid_modKernel {s t} (S : Space E n s) (V : Space E b t) a β (h𝔪 : Nonempty 𝔪.places) {Ψ}
    (hΨ : ∀ y, Ψ y ≠ 0 → HasLeftInv y) P h : S.IsRapid (modKernel S V a β 𝔪 Ψ P · h)
  | B => let ⟨_, _, _, c⟩ :=
      pairTheta_modDatum_decay S V a β h𝔪 hΨ B; ⟨_, (c _ h · (weightedNorm_polyVector_ne_top _ P))⟩

explicitMatchingOfSum.name: explicit_matching_of_sum
explicitMatchingOfSum.statement:
lemma explicit_matching_of_sum {s t} (V : Space E b t) {𝔪} (U : Space E n s) {a β β' e χ} (hχ :
  IsTameFor 𝔪 (β * β') e χ) {Ξ F : _ → ℂ} {κ} (hF : ∀ x, κ * stdClassSum (Kf ..) (fun h ↦
  Ξ h * modKernelI V a β 𝔪 (χ ·.det) 1 x h) = F x) 𝔫 (φ : 𝔪.ideal ≤ 𝔫.ideal) f {P g} {K : _ → _ →
  _} {κ'} (hK : ∀ Φ Ψ, IsPartner ⊤ (.refl _) χ⁻¹ Φ Ψ → ∀ h, κ' * stdClassSum (Kf E n) (K Φ h) = ∫ x,
  modKernel V ((stdSpace ..).sum U) a (β * β') 𝔪 Ψ (renameRowsCols .inr id P) x (.sum ((1, h),
  g)) ∂V.quotMeasure) : κ' * (κ / card (GL b 𝔫.ResRing)) * stdClassSum (Kf ..) (stdClassSum (Kf ..)
  fun h ↦ Ξ h * K (fun x ↦ χ x.toCols₂.det * ∑ k : GL b 𝔫.ResRing, f ((x.toCols₂⁻¹ * x.toCols₁).map
  (factor φ) * k.1)) h ·) = ∫ x, F x * modKernel V U a β' 𝔫 f P x g ∂V.quotMeasure

binders.name: hF
binders.type: ∀ x, κ * stdClassSum (Kf ..) (fun h ↦ Ξ h * modKernelI V a β 𝔪 (χ ·.det) 1 x h) = F x

binders.name: hK
binders.type: ∀ Φ Ψ, IsPartner ⊤ (.refl _) χ⁻¹ Φ Ψ → ∀ h, κ' * stdClassSum (Kf E n) (K Φ h) = ∫ x, modKernel V ((stdSpace ..).sum U) a (β * β') 𝔪 Ψ (renameRowsCols .inr id P) x (.sum ((1, h), g)) ∂V.quotMeasure

classSumRowStabilizer.name: stdClassSum_rowStabilizer_eq
classSumRowStabilizer.statement:
lemma stdClassSum_rowStabilizer_eq {r c S} [Fintype r] [CommRing S] {s α β γ χ P g} {W : Space E _
  s} (hα : IsTameFor 𝔪 α γ χ) (hP : ∀ u, realPairWeil (s := s) (s' := 1) γ 0 (1, u) (polyVector _
  P) = polyVector _ P) (φ : 𝔪.ResRing →+* S) (w : Matrix c b S) (e : r ↪ b) {F : Matrix b n _ → ℂ}
  (hF : ∀ A ∈ rowStabilizer φ w e, ∀ y, F (A.1 * y) = F y) : stdClassSum
  (𝔪.levelOfSubgroup (rowStabilizer φ w e)) (modKernelI W α β 𝔪 (fun x ↦ columnDatum χ φ w e
  (x.toCols₂.submatrix id e) * ite (FixesColsOff e x.toCols₂) (F x.toCols₁) 0) P g) = stdClassSum
  (Kf E b) (modKernelI W α β 𝔪 (fun x ↦ χ x.toCols₂.det * F (x.toCols₂⁻¹ * x.toCols₁)) P g)

binders.name: hP
binders.type: ∀ u, realPairWeil (s := s) (s' := 1) γ 0 (1, u) (polyVector _ P) = polyVector _ P

binders.name: hF
binders.type: ∀ A ∈ rowStabilizer φ w e, ∀ y, F (A.1 * y) = F y

explicitmatching.name: explicit_matching
explicitmatching.statement:
lemma explicit_matching {E} [Field E] [CMType E] [WeilData E] {n m a b p l} [Fintype n] [Fintype m]
  [Fintype a] [Fintype b] [Fintype p] [Fintype l] {s} (W : Space E n s) (f : p ⊕ l ≃ b) (V' : Space
  E _ (blockSigns f)) σ e (j : m ⊕ l ≃ n) (hj : s = blockSigns j) {d} (hd : card a = card b + 2 * d)
  (hn : 2 * card l + 2 ≤ card n) ι [∀ τ, Fintype (ι τ)] : ∃ C, ∀ {𝔪 α γ χ}, IsTameFor 𝔪 α γ χ →
  (∀ τ, γ τ = card l - card (ι τ)) → ∃ c, ‖c‖ ^ 2 = C / lValueProd 𝔪.places
  (α⁻¹ * upsilonU1 ^ (card b + d)) d ∧ ∀ η {Φ Ψ}, IsPartner ⊤ σ χ⁻¹ Φ Ψ → ∀ β g, c * stdClassSum
  (Kf E a) (modKernelI W α β 𝔪 Φ (renameRowsCols id (j ∘ .inl) (stackedDetProd e η)) g ·) = ∫ x,
  modKernel V' W (α / β) α 𝔪 Ψ (matchedPoly (ι := ι) f j η) x g ∂V'.quotMeasure

classSumDet.name: stdClassSum_det_modKernel_eq
classSumDet.statement:
lemma stdClassSum_det_modKernel_eq (he : Even m) (c : _ → ℕ) : ∃ C, ∀ {𝔪 α χ},
  IsTameFor 𝔪 α (-c ·) χ → ∃ γ, ‖γ‖ ^ 2 = C / lValueProd
  𝔪.places (α⁻¹ * upsilonU1 ^ (m / 2)) (m / 2) ∧ ∀ g, γ * stdClassSum (Kf E (Fin m))
  (modKernelI (stdSpace ..) α α 𝔪 (χ ·.det) (∏ τ, letterMinor τ id id ^ c τ) g) = 1

carrierIdentity.name: stdClassSum_carrierXi_eq_carrierForm
carrierIdentity.statement:
lemma stdClassSum_carrierXi_eq_carrierForm (he : Even m) : ∃ C, ∀ {𝔪 c χ}, IsTameFor 𝔪 c 0 χ →
  ∃ γ, ‖γ‖ ^ 2 = C / (lValueProd 𝔪.places (c⁻¹ * upsilonU1 ^ m) m * lValueProd 𝔪.places
  (c * upsilonU1 ^ (m / 2)) (m / 2)) ∧ ∀ x, γ * stdClassSum (Kf ..) (fun h ↦ carrierXi m c h *
  modKernelI (signedSpace ..) (upsilonU1 ^ m) c 𝔪 (χ ·.det) 1 x h) = carrierForm E m x
